section.heading: ## User library — The sign-up page asks for an email and a password
section.text: - The sign-up page asks for an email and a password.
smoke: - Where sign-up is open, sign up with a new address: you are signed in.

notes: Pieces 2 and 3 of the sign-up plan, the library's part, on top of feat/sign-up-the-switch-and-the-log-in-line (piece 1, published first). POST /user/signup without an invite asks an email and a password and makes the account with an empty name (a blank one gets the log-in route's sentence, now user-server BlankCredentials.REFUSAL); a request already signed in makes nothing and keeps its session; a welcome mail that cannot be sent no longer fails the sign-up. The invite rule may answer for one address (InviteConfig.inviteRequiredSentence, DefaultInviteConfigFactory.getConfigFor, both optional); the route asks it first (Signup.inviteRequiredOf), before the throwaway-mail list and the product's guard. user-ui: the form without an invite is Email, Password, the product's sentence above Sign up (AuthPageProduct.signupAgreementSentence, optional) and Have an account? Log in (AuthQuietLink); it carries the hidden field website and the product's timing token (AuthPageProduct.signupFormToken, optional); the invite form is unchanged. Held: nothing landed or published.
